#
# PROVENANCE: the live capture for this dialog is GONE. herdr classified all
# five frozen panes as idle/done for the ~12 hours they sat on this dialog
# (BUTCHR-5's root cause — our only blocked-detector never saw it, so nothing
# ever read the pane while it was showing), and by the time the story agent
# tried to recover it (~14 hours later) `herdr pane read` returned unrelated,
# shallow scrollback with no trace of it and the butchr journal had no copy
# either. The ONLY surviving record is the operator's own hand transcription,
# quoted verbatim in the BUTCHR-16 ticket description:
#
#   "We recommend Opus 5 at medium effort"
#   1. Switch Opus 5 to medium effort
#   2. Keep high
#
# WHAT IS REAL: the question wording and the two option strings above,
# exactly as transcribed by the operator.
#
# WHAT IS GUESSED (labelled here, not silent): the ❯ cursor position (placed
# on option 1, "Switch ... to medium effort" — matching the recommended
# choice being highlighted first, the same convention the real "Resume from
# summary (recommended)" dialog uses, see test/unit/prompt.test.ts); the
# footer line ("Enter to confirm · Esc to cancel", copied from every other
# real Claude Code selection dialog captured in this repo); and the absence
# of any other trailing chrome — nobody knows what, if anything, this
# specific dialog renders around the question and options, so none is
# invented here.

# If this dialog appears again, CAPTURE IT FRESH (`herdr pane read <pane>
